reviewer: assistant; single-pass text-only judgment, not independent human adjudication
scope: 36 randomly sampled training-only short reviews, 12 per rating-derived class; no model predictions consulted
correction_rationale: The first, second and fifth texts directly praise performance/convenience despite a three-star rating; the third and fourth criticize battery longevity.
exclude_ambiguous: they are batteries power my flashlight
exclusion_rationale: Incomplete or non-review content, or insufficient evidence to distinguish neutral description from mild approval/disapproval. No label is forced.
limitations: The remaining corpus and every evaluation label remain rating proxies. This small audit cannot estimate label-noise prevalence reliably, and the assistant judgments require human review before a deployment decision.
